services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Your boat, your adventure. Exclusive sailing experiences for birthdays, anniversaries, family outings, and celebrations on the Space Coast. Groups of 7-20 guests are accommodated through a bareboat (demise) charter arrangement. Sometimes you just want the boat to yourself. Our Private Catamaran Charters offer the ultimate way to experience the beautiful waters of Cocoa Beach and Merritt Island. When you book a private charter, you are reserving the entire vessel exclusively for your group, ensuring a completely personalized and intimate experience on the water. policies: Safety and Comfort Don’t be concerned about rough weather or high seas.
We can enjoy catamaran cruising on almost any day regardless of weather conditions!
If illegal drugs are discovered onboard, the trip will be terminated immediately and return to the dock without a refund.
Cancellation & Weather Policy All trips are refundable until 5 days / 120 hours prior to departure.
Within 5 days of departure, trips are non-refundable unless Trip Protection was purchased at checkout.
The Trip Protection fee is non-refundable.
This includes cancellations due to cloudy skies, imperfect weather, travel delays, or a guest choosing not to attend.
